user: I'm CUS-0004. Transaction TX-0401, 240.00 EUR: the goods never arrived. Which reason code applies?
answer:
What I did
- I looked up your account and recent transactions and checked Verta's dispute rules.

What I found
- Transaction TX-0401: 240.00 EUR, TechMart Online, date 2026-07-20, status settled.
- Verta reason code for "goods never arrived" is goods_not_received. The documentation shows a 90-day dispute window for goods_not_received.

What this means
- The applicable reason code for "goods never arrived" is goods_not_received.
- TX-0401 is dated 2026-07-20, which is past the 90-day window, so it is outside the goods_not_received chargeback window and would not be eligible to be opened under that reason now.

Next steps
- If you want, I can run a formal eligibility check for TX-0401 (required before we open any dispute) and confirm the result. Tell me if you want me to do that or if you'd like me to escalate this to a human agent for further review.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
